cards.ex: After a long week, I just want to chill out at home.
cards.exUz: Uzoq haftadan keyin, men uyda dam olmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtingizni tinch va xotirjam o'tkazish, stressdan xalos bo'lish.

cards.ex: Let's kick back and watch a movie tonight.
cards.exUz: Keling, yonboshlab, bugun kechqurun kino ko'raylik.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish, relaxatsiya holatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm really getting into photography lately.
cards.exUz: So'nggi paytlarda men fotografiyaga juda qiziqib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir qiziqib, unga mehr qo'yish, xobbi sifatida tanlash.

cards.ex: I go for a run to blow off steam after a stressful day.
cards.exUz: Stressli kundan keyin men g'azabimni chiqarish uchun yuguraman.
cards.uzDef: Stressni yo'qotish uchun kuch sarflash, energiyani chiqarish.

cards.ex: Traveling is a nice change of pace from my usual routine.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilish - mening odatiy tartibimdan yaxshi o'zgarish.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik tartibdan farqli, yangi narsa qilish.

cards.ex: He's a real sports fanatic; he knows everything about football.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy sport muxlisi; u futbol haqida hamma narsani biladi.
cards.uzDef: Sportga juda qiziqadigan, sportni sevuvchi odam.

cards.ex: Reading is my favorite leisure activity.
cards.exUz: O'qish - mening sevimli hordiq faoliyatim.
cards.uzDef: Bo'sh vaqtda zavqlanish uchun qilinadigan ish.

cards.ex: I want to take up painting in my free time.
cards.exUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda rasm chizishni boshlamoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Yangi xobbi yoki mashg'ulotni boshlash.

cards.ex: We should get together for coffee sometime.
cards.exUz: Qachondir birga qahva ichish uchun yig'ilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlar yoki oila a'zolari bilan birga vaqt o'tkazish.

cards.ex: We don't know what we're doing tonight; let's just play it by ear.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun kechqurun nima qilishimizni bilmaymiz; shunchaki ko'rsatar.
cards.uzDef: Reja qilmasdan, vaziyatga qarab harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I was a couch potato all weekend, watching TV.
cards.exUz: Men butun hafta davomida divanda televizor ko'rib dangasalik qildim.
cards.uzDef: Televizor oldida ko'p vaqt o'tkazadigan dangasa odam.

cards.ex: In my downtime, I like to read or listen to music.
cards.exUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda men kitob o'qishni yoki musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan yoki mashg'ulotlardan bo'sh bo'lgan vaqtda.

cards.ex: She has a keen interest in history.
cards.exUz: U tarixga katta qiziqish bildiradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir katta qiziqish yoki ishtiyoq bilan qarash.

cards.ex: I'm a night owl; I prefer to work late.
cards.exUz: Men tungi qushman; kechgacha ishlashni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha uxlolmaydigan, tungi hayotga moyil odam.

cards.ex: He's an early bird; he's always up before sunrise.
cards.exUz: U ertalabki qush; u har doim quyosh chiqishidan oldin turadi.
cards.uzDef: Ertalab turishni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: I'm always on the go; I rarely have time to relax.
cards.exUz: Men doimo harakatdaman; menda dam olishga vaqtim kam.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy harakatda, band bo'lish.

cards.ex: I get a kick out of watching comedies.
cards.exUz: Men komediyalarni tomosha qilishdan zavqlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir katta zavq olish, xursand bo'lish.

cards.ex: We had a blast at the party last night.
cards.exUz: Biz kecha kechqurun ziyofatda juda kayf qildik.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazish, ko'ngil ochish.

cards.ex: I'm down to do whatever you want tonight.
cards.exUz: Men bugun kechqurun nima qilishni xohlasangiz, tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga tayyor va xohishi bor bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm going to hit the gym after work.
cards.exUz: Men ishdan keyin sport zaliga boraman.
cards.uzDef: Sport bilan shug'ullanish uchun sport zaliga borish.

cards.ex: She's very artsy; she loves painting and drawing.
cards.exUz: U juda san'atkorona; u rasm chizishni va chizishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: San'atga qiziqishi bor, ijodkorona odam.

cards.ex: Let's take a breather before we start the next project.
cards.exUz: Keyingi loyihani boshlashdan oldin nafas rostlaylik.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa tanaffus qilish, dam olish.

cards.ex: He's an outdoor enthusiast; he loves hiking and camping.
cards.exUz: U tabiat shinavandasi; u piyoda yurishni va lager qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatda vaqt o'tkazishni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: I want to dive into learning a new language.
cards.exUz: Men yangi tilni o'rganishga sho'ng'imoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir chuqur kirib ketish, qiziqib qolish.

cards.ex: I prefer to be on the sidelines during team sports.
cards.exUz: Men jamoaviy sport turlarida chetda bo'lishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishda ishtirok etmasdan, kuzatib turish.

cards.ex: She's a social butterfly; she knows everyone at the party.
cards.exUz: U do'stonalik timsoli; u ziyofatda hamma odamni taniydi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p odamlar bilan aloqa o'rnatadigan, do'stonalik qobiliyatiga ega odam.

cards.ex: I like to putter around in the garden on weekends.
cards.exUz: Men dam olish kunlari bog'da bekor yurishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday aniq maqsadga ega bo'lmasdan vaqt o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The kids need to burn some energy, let's go to the park.
cards.exUz: Bolalarning energiya sarflashlari kerak, keling parkga boramiz.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy mashqlar orqali energiyani yo'qotish.

cards.ex: Gardening is a relaxing pastime for many people.
cards.exUz: Bog'dorchilik ko'p odamlar uchun dam beruvchi mashg'ulotdir.
cards.uzDef: Bo'sh vaqtda qilinadigan yoqimli mashg'ulot.

cards.ex: I got hooked on that TV show after just one episode.
cards.exUz: Men o'sha televizion ko'rsatuvga birinchi qismdan keyin bog'lanib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir juda qiziqib qolish, unga bog'lanib qolish.
